trades.note: UMich sentiment news: sell-off absorbed -> long before candle close. Target: next major level (~overnight high). Entry ~09:06 CT. R excl. commissions.; next level 7853.75 touched 10:19; entry = Chris's fill

review.title: after-review

sections.h: WHAT HAPPENED AFTER (as of 12:22 CT bar, ~2h after exit)
bullets: 1R (7842.50) reached 09:25, 1.5R 09:51, 2R (7850.75) 09:58, exit 7853.75 at 10:19 = the 15m/overnight-high zone (tool level 7853.50).

After the exit price pulled back only to 7842.50 (10:34), never back to the 7834.25 entry, then ran to 7863.25 at 11:51 (+9.50 pts above the exit; +29.0 pts / +3.5R from entry). Last bar 12:22 closed 7853.50, back near the exit.

sections.text: Yes, reasonable. Stop 7826.00 sat just under the 08:44 low (7826.50), a real structural stop, and risk was 8.25 pts for a planned 2.36R. The entry bar's own low was 7832.00 (2.25 pts under the fill) and the lowest 1m print after that bar was 7832.25 (09:11), so the stop was never close. Entering before the candle closed gave a better price than waiting for confirmation (the 09:07 bar traded 7834.50 to 7837.50 and kept going), but it carried more risk if the absorption had failed.

sections.h: WHAT COULD WE HAVE DONE BETTER DURING THE TRADE?
sections.text: Not much on the exit: 7853.75 was the high of that leg. Possible improvements: move the stop to breakeven after 1R (09:25) — the lowest print afterward was 7834.75 at ~09:42, only 0.50 above entry, so a breakeven stop would barely have survived; a stop moved under the 09:42 swing low (~7834.75) or under the 15m swing lows (7832.00/7832.75) once past 1R would have cut risk without being taken out. Have the target and a plan for the rest decided before entry.

Optional. Taking half at 2R (7850.75, 09:58) and the rest at the level would have lowered the result slightly (about +2.2R blended instead of +2.36R) but locked in a win earlier. The full exit at the level was the better result here, but it is only clearly better in hindsight, and price reversed from the level for ~11 pts into 10:34.

Possibly once. The pullback around 09:42 (low 7834.75, a retest of the entry zone) offered a lower-risk add with a stop under 7832.00 (~2.75 pts risk). An add on the 09:50 break above the 7844.25 RTH high would have had a bigger stop and less reward. Adding makes the trade bigger when it already worked; only worth it with a pre-set size plan.

With hindsight a runner past 7853.75 would have reached 7863.25 (+3.5R), but 7858.25 (previous session high) was the next real level and price closed back at 7853.50, so exiting at the first major level was defensible.

blocks.label: Chris's read
blocks.text: Wanted the sell-off to continue on the UMich sentiment news. When the selling got absorbed, that was the signal to go long. Didn't wait for the candle to close; when UMich wants to move it moves right away. Targeted the next major level (the overnight high).

blocks.label: Grok's opinion
blocks.text: Good trade process: clear trigger, structural stop, defined target, and the exit matched a real level. The one soft spot is entering before the candle closed; it worked, but it is a lower-confirmation habit, so size it as such and keep the stop honest. Next time, write the size and the scale-out/trail plan down before entry. One trade is not a pattern; the data here is 1m Yahoo bars, so exact fills and the order of prints inside a minute are not known.
